channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Is the memecoin easy-money era over? The 12 biggest memecoins sit 44% to 98% below their highs
item.description: Traders are arguing about whether memecoins still pay. We skipped the opinions and pulled the numbers: prices against all-time highs, Pump.fun's revenue and the size of the meme market today.

item.title: 6 crypto projects are giving up their own chains for Solana, Ethereum, Base, Sui and Arc
item.description: A table of nine "chain migrations" is going viral. We checked each row against the projects' own posts: six are confirmed, three are not. Here is where each one is going and what its token did since.

item.title: Rumor vs record: did hackers pay $15 to drain $2.5 billion from Binance in 20 minutes?
item.description: Headlines about the Binance hack keep spreading. We checked the most shared claims against Binance's own report, DeepSea's hack tracker and CoinGecko prices. The single-transaction part holds up. The "$15" and "20 minutes" framing misses the story.

item.title: Harmony's ONE jumped 85% in a day and a half. Trading hit 3.4 times its market value
item.description: ONE went from about $0.00106 to $0.00196 on CoinGecko as daily trading rose from about $2 million to $97 million. We could not confirm an official reason for it.

item.title: One Mantle shark swapped ether tokens 208 times in a day. Its 30-day result: minus $2,400
item.description: The wallet traded about $314,000 between WETH and Mantle's staked ether token in 24 hours. After 2,219 closed trades in 30 days, it is slightly in the red.

item.title: An Ethereum shark was down $159,600 for the month. Two days later it's up $18,100
item.description: DeepSea's PnL table shows one wallet's 30-day result swing by $130,000 in less than a day of closed trades, while ether went nowhere for the week. It now has the best 7-day result of any Ethereum shark with a 7-day figure.

item.title: An Avalanche shark swapped $1.45 million of Aave USDC deposits for Benqi's in two trades
item.description: DeepSea logged the switch as both the second-largest net shark buy and the second-largest net shark sell of the day across all chains. The wallet's closed trades in the last 30 days: five, all winners.

item.title: CYBER jumped 53% in about a day, then gave back 20%. Sharks on Optimism bought $668,000
item.description: CoinGecko shows the small-cap CYBER token trading four times its market value in 24 hours, with South Korea's Upbit the busiest market. DeepSea's shark wallets were net buyers on Optimism over a day in which the price fell.

item.title: DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders: $256 million in weekly profit, then $110 million
item.description: The 7-day profit shown for the crash-week winners on DeepSea's boards fell by more than half in 24 hours. The top two influencers' figures halved, and sharks are still down $3.15 million on closed trades.

item.title: Sharks "sold" $16.31 million of uniBTC on Berachain. CoinGecko saw $591 of trading
item.description: DeepSea's live feed logged two wallets moving about 212 uniBTC out on Berachain in 24 hours. One of them is a DEX pool, and CoinGecko counted less than $600 of uniBTC trading worldwide in the same day.

item.title: Rumor vs record: was Chainalysis hit by AI, and did attackers see case files?
item.description: Claims about the Chainalysis breach kept spreading as the company posted its November 6 update. We checked eight of them against Chainalysis's own incident page: two are wrong or out of date, and two have no evidence behind them yet.

item.title: Ruble token A7A5 still trades on Uniswap 15 months after sanctions, for about $1,500 a day
item.description: In August 2025, Treasury sanctioned A7A5's issuer along with Garantex and its successor, Grinex. FinCEN's November 6, 2026, MEXC order put new numbers on all three. Public data shows the token still trades in tiny amounts, but it cannot show the transfers between agents.

item.title: MEXC's tracked wallets shed $166 million before FinCEN's order. Then MX fell 6%
item.description: DeepSea's MEXC wallets fell from $1.08 billion to about $918 million between November 5 and early November 6, before FinCEN moved against the exchange. They have barely moved since, and the data does not show why.

item.title: FinCEN and the Fed drop the 2020 plan to cut the travel rule threshold to $250
item.description: The 2020 proposal would have lowered the cross-border threshold from $3,000 to $250 and written crypto into the definition of "money." FinCEN pulled it on November 6, 2026.

item.title: Rumor vs record: what viral posts got right and wrong about the U.S. move against MEXC
item.description: Posts about FinCEN's MEXC order spread fast on November 6 and 7, 2026. We checked each claim against FinCEN's own order. Most numbers hold up; two points do not.

item.title: FinCEN cuts MEXC off from U.S. banks over $16.7 billion in likely illicit flows
item.description: The U.S. Treasury's FinCEN ordered U.S. financial institutions on November 6, 2026, to stop sending funds to or receiving funds from MEXC Global. The ban starts 30 days after the order runs in the Federal Register.

item.title: What 9 on-chain analytics tools are built for, from block explorers to compliance suites
item.description: Arkham, Nansen, Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Dune, Glassnode, DefiLlama, block explorers and DeepSea all read public blockchain data, but each is built for a different job. Here is what each one does, what is free and who uses it, from each tool's own site.

item.title: Chainalysis now says login tokens for every user were exposed. All must reset passwords
item.description: The crypto tracing firm first said only names and emails were reached. Its latest update says live tokens for every user and password hashes were exposed, and its Reactor and Data Solutions products are still offline.

item.title: A Nasdaq-listed HYPE holder wants to be a US futures broker. HYPE is down 15% in a week
item.description: Nasdaq-listed Hyperliquid Strategies says a subsidiary has applied to become a futures commission merchant, a step toward offering Hyperliquid perps to US customers. It also booked a $620.6 million quarterly profit, nearly all of it paper gains on HYPE.

item.title: Shorts are paying longs on 21.5% of ether's open futures bets, against 1.4% for bitcoin
item.description: CoinGecko's data on 287 bitcoin and ether perp markets shows short sellers paying to hold their bets on 21.5% of ether's open interest, against 1.4% for bitcoin, a day after the sell-off.

item.title: Hyperliquid holds $14.9 billion in open bets, second only to Binance on CoinGecko
item.description: CoinGecko ranks Hyperliquid second of all derivatives exchanges by open interest, about $14.9 billion. Its traders also churn their positions far less than on centralized rivals.

item.title: Stock and oil bets outtraded crypto on Hyperliquid: $9.96 billion vs. $9.67 billion
item.description: CoinGecko's market data for Hyperliquid shows its 165 builder-run markets, almost all on stocks, indexes and commodities, did more volume than its 179 crypto perps as bitcoin fell 5%.

item.title: The shark that took $10 million out of Aave on Arbitrum put $8.32 million back
item.description: A day after one wallet drove an $8.35 million net outflow from Aave's USDC pool, it bought back almost all of it. The 7-day net is now just minus $27,800.

item.title: One shark sold $2.59 million of LYK. The token's Arbitrum pool holds $396
item.description: DeepSea logged big shark selling in two layer 2 tokens, LayerK's LYK and Linea's LINEA. LYK's public markets were far too small to absorb what was counted.

item.title: Two sharks bought $3.74 million of USD₮0 on Unichain in a day and sold just $75,000
item.description: A day after sharks were net sellers of the dollar token on Unichain, two wallets flipped to heavy buying. One of them also bought $4 million on Optimism.

item.title: Sharks bought $3.08 million of tokenized SpaceX on Arbitrum. Its DEX pool traded $56,000
item.description: Two shark wallets kept buying rSPCX and rCRCL, tokens CoinGecko lists as tokenized SpaceX and Circle stock, even as both fell. Almost none of it went through the public pool.

item.title: Lido lost $1.8 billion in value in a day. Did anyone actually leave?
item.description: DefiLlama shows DeFi's biggest protocols shrank 4% to 8% in 24 hours. Compared with CoinGecko prices, most of that looks like falling prices, not withdrawals.

item.title: Bitcoin fell 5% in four hours. Fees peaked at just 12 sats after a 67-minute wait
item.description: mempool.space data shows the November 5 sell-off barely stressed the Bitcoin network. The biggest fee jumps came when blocks were slow, not when panic peaked.

item.title: Curve's trading volume nearly quadrupled to $831 million as crypto sold off
item.description: DefiLlama shows the stablecoin swap venue went from $215 million to $831 million in a day, while total DEX volume rose less than 3% and several big DEXs slowed. Its fees jumped about eightfold.

item.title: Stablecoin supply shrank $5 billion in six days. USDT fell the most
item.description: DefiLlama shows the total supply of dollar stablecoins fell every day from October 30 to November 5, the day bitcoin dropped below $76,000. Tether's USDT supply fell $2.76 billion in a week.

item.title: Exchange wallets lost $11.45 billion in 18 hours. Mostly price, not withdrawals
item.description: DeepSea's exchange list shrank 4.7% as bitcoin fell about 6%. Binance's holdings dropped $6.84 billion, and MEXC fell 15.8%, the steepest among large exchanges.

item.title: 71 of 100 shark wallets lost money on closed trades in crash week, $5.85 million in all
item.description: DeepSea's realized profit table shows large traders came out behind as bitcoin fell. Three wallets made up 63% of the loss, and one Optimism wallet won 3 of 61 trades.

item.title: Influencer slingoor turned a $686,000 week into $9.38 million as bitcoin fell
item.description: DeepSea's 7-day KOL board changed fast in the November 5 sell-off. The top two influencers now hold 91% of the profit shown in the top 100.

item.title: Bitcoin fell 6%. DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders went from $98M to $256M
item.description: In about 18 hours, the 7-day profit of DeepSea's ten best wallets more than doubled. All ten trade perps on Hyperliquid, and the leader alone added $47.9 million.

item.title: Greece puts a 10% crypto gains tax to a final vote. Staking income would pay 15%
item.description: Greece's finance minister brought a bill with dedicated crypto tax rules to a final vote in parliament on November 4. Gains up to 500 euros a year would be tax free.

item.title: GL1 Org launches with HSBC and JPMorgan on its member list. What will it build?
item.description: Global financial institutions have formed the Global Layer One Organisation to push shared rules for tokenized markets. Its site lists HSBC, JPMorgan, MUFG, Forge and Standard Chartered as members. The project began at Singapore's central bank in 2024.

item.title: Base now aims for five blocks a second. What does the Denim upgrade break for apps?
item.description: Base's Denim upgrade was set to switch mainnet from one block every 2 seconds to one every 200 milliseconds on November 5. Anything that counts blocks to measure time now runs 10 times faster.

item.title: Canary's staked INJ ETF heads to Nasdaq as INJC. Fees will take up to 30% of rewards
item.description: Canary's Staked INJ ETF filed its final prospectus on November 4. The fund plans to stake most of its Injective tokens and keep 70% of the rewards. INJ rose 2.5% in a day the rest of the market fell.

item.title: Bitcoin lost $4,400 in four hours. Why did ETH and XRP fall even harder?
item.description: Bitcoin slid from about $80,300 to under $76,000 on November 5, most of it between 9 a.m. and 11 a.m. ET. Ether, Solana and XRP dropped 7% to 9%, and the whole crypto market shed about 8% in a day.

item.title: Trump Media moved 4,259 BTC to Crypto.com from its collateral wallets. A move is not a sale
item.description: Two transfers worth about $344 million left wallets that Arkham labels as collateral for Trump Media's $1 billion convertible notes, weeks before holders can ask for their money back.

item.title: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin lost about $49 million on 17 chains. It says customers lose nothing
item.description: Mercado Bitcoin says it contained a security incident on November 2, 2026, and that no customer will lose assets. Chainalysis puts the theft at about $49 million and says close to $9 million has been frozen.

item.title: Hackers drained French bank Arkéa's own account. It calls a $133 million estimate about right
item.description: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed a cyberattack that sent fraudulent transfers out of the bank's own account, possibly into crypto. It denies the attackers came in through Fortuneo and says customer savings are safe.

item.title: One shark sold $80.5 million of Aave-deposited USDT in an hour. Its 7-day loss: $1.87 million
item.description: The Ethereum wallet ending 4312 moved more than $280 million in a day, mostly in and out of Aave. DeepSea's PnL table shows it with the biggest 7-day realized loss it tracks.

item.title: Seized UK government wallets rank seventh on DeepSea's exchange list, at $3.95 billion
item.description: DeepSea's exchange rankings mix trading venues with seized and long-silent wallets, including $574.14 million in failed QuadrigaCX's. Bitfinex ranks second at $31.27 billion, and one Coincheck wallet holds $3.42 billion.

item.title: Two sharks ran $51.7 million through Aave's USDC pool on Arbitrum. Net $8.35 million out
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour feed shows $30 million of Aave's USDC receipt token sold and $21.65 million bought. One wallet did most of the round trip.

item.title: Smart money is 15 to 1 long on ether, but only 2 to 1 on Zcash
item.description: DeepSea's Long / Short panel shows all seven of its biggest coins leaning long. Ether and NEAR are the most one-sided, while bitcoin carries the largest short bets.

item.title: A net 16,251 bitcoin flowed onto exchanges in a week. Binance took in the most
item.description: DeepSea's dashboard shows a net 1,387 BTC flowed into exchanges in 24 hours, with Binance up 2,479 BTC while Kraken and Bitfinex lost coins.

item.title: DeepSea's top 10 smart money traders made $98.4 million in a week, all on Hyperliquid perps
item.description: The first 41 names on DeepSea's 7-day leaderboard are Hyperliquid perpetual futures traders. The leader made $16.44 million on $208 million of assets.

item.title: Sharks bought $10.25 million of WLD on Optimism in a day while its price fell 4%
item.description: Thirteen big wallets made 240 WLD trades in 24 hours and net bought about $4.31 million. WLD itself fell 4% on CoinGecko.

item.title: Sharks sold $9.52 million of USD₮0 on Berachain in a day, $3.39 million in the last hour
item.description: One busy wallet made 260 shark trades on Berachain, where DeepSea logged 263 in Tether's cross-chain dollar token. A day earlier the 24-hour selling was about a quarter of the size.
